issues.description: The template's Bitmap24.hpp declares the constructors, destructor, and all methods as private (class members are under a private: section), while main.cpp in the template instantiates Bitmap24 (Bitmap24 bitmap;) and the solution version of Bitmap24.hpp exposes these as public. This visibility mismatch will prevent students from constructing or using Bitmap24 as shown in the provided main, causing compilation errors and confusion about the intended API.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructors, destructor, and the public API of Bitmap24 (resize_buffer, save, set) public in the template header so the class can be instantiated and used from main. For example, add a public: section exposing the constructors and methods (or move the existing declarations under public:) to match the solution's class visibility.
